Schema for Movies
Intent: BuyMovieTickets
required slots: movie name,number of tickets,show date,location,show time,show type

Intent: FindMovies
required slots: location
optional slots: theater name,genre,show type
Intent: GetTimesForMovie

User: Can you look in the Newark area?

[{'genre': 'Supernatural', 'location': 'Newark', 'movie_name': 'IT Chapter Two', 'price': '10', 'show_type': 'regular', 'street_address': '400 Newpark Mall', 'theater_name': 'AMC NewPark 12'}]
End Search Results
System: Sure I can, I found 1 movie called IT Chapter Two that fits your wants

System: Confirming that you want 3 regular tickets to IT Chapter Two at 10:15 pm on March 10th in Newark
User: Yes that's right
System: ApiCall(method='BuyMovieTickets', parameters={'location': 'Newark', 'movie_name': 'IT Chapter Two', 'number_of_tickets': '3', 'show_date': '2019-03-10', 'show_time': '22:15', 'show_type': 'regular'})
